Recorded claim:
At revision 2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555, an agent report attributes Exchange test failures to ancestor 110c9c370b858b4f4e8fb48a827573e268e63b4e changing the password input ID while two tests still query #password. The report says the query returns null and recommends selecting the password input by type within passwordStep in both tests. Check current source before applying this to another revision. The reported repair passed Try, but it was absent from this checkout, and no local browser test ran there.
